messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Religion and values in Algeria, Ghana, Indonesia, Jordan, Kenya, Cambodia, Sri Lanka, Mongolia, Malawi, Malaysia, Nigeria, Nepal, Singapore, and Viet Nam during the 2010s, matching this research need: Cross-national survey data on religiosity, beliefs, religious practices, attitudes toward gender roles, sexuality, science, state-religion relations, interreligious tolerance, social distance, trust, and demographics including family religious background and political behavior.
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: Pew Research Center 2012 the world's Muslims unity diversity dataset 2013 attitudes religion survey countries
